summary: The current upstream head improves path resolution via GetFinalPathNameByHandleW, but contains three issues: path matching fails when handle resolution falls back to NT kernel format because UI/module lookups only record DOS paths; the HandleInfo::kernel_file_name field and path_to_kernel_name function were renamed/removed contrary to stated backward-compatibility goals; and regression unit tests for canonical and kernel path resolution are missing. A candidate patch addressing all three findings was validated against the exact upstream head.

proposed_comments.body:
### Match both canonical DOS paths and fallback kernel names to prevent silently missed locking processes

**Severity:** high`n
In FileLocksmith.cpp ( ind_processes_recursive), selected search paths and process modules are registered in kernel_names_files and kernel_names_dirs using only path_to_canonical_name. However, in the handles() loop,  ile_handle_to_path falls back to  ile_handle_to_kernel_name (\Device\...) when GetFinalPathNameByHandleW fails (e.g. for handles opened without FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES or over certain network/virtual filesystems). Because kernel_paths_contain compares the handle name against the map keys, comparing \Device\... against <local-path> will never match, silently missing locking processes. Register both the canonical DOS path and the fallback kernel name in kernel_names_files / kernel_names_dirs for each selected path and module so matching succeeds regardless of which resolution path was taken.

confidence.rationale: The format mismatch is directly visible in find_processes_recursive and the candidate fix resolving both formats passed the unit test suite.

proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The fix coordinates map registration across selected paths, process modules, and the fallback handle matching path across FileLocksmith.cpp and NtdllExtensions; no single localized replacement is independently safe.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The fix coordinates map registration across selected paths, process modules, and the fallback handle matching path across FileLocksmith.cpp and NtdllExtensions; no single localized replacement is independently safe.
proposed_comments.title: Match both canonical DOS paths and fallback kernel names to prevent silently missed locking processes

proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve HandleInfo::kernel_file_name and path_to_kernel_name for source compatibility

**Severity:** medium`n
In NtdllExtensions.h, HandleInfo::kernel_file_name was renamed to  ile_path, and path_to_kernel_name was renamed to path_to_canonical_name. The PR description explicitly notes that kernel_file_name should be preserved for binary and source compatibility across consuming modules and UI layers. Retain HandleInfo::kernel_file_name (or provide a compatibility alias) and provide path_to_kernel_name as a wrapper alongside path_to_canonical_name so external callers and existing tests continue to compile.

confidence.rationale: The PR description explicitly documents the intent to preserve kernel_file_name for compatibility, which was broken by the header field rename.

proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The naming compatibility spans public structs and functions across NtdllExtensions.h, NtdllExtensions.cpp, and FileLocksmith.cpp.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The naming compatibility spans public structs and functions across NtdllExtensions.h, NtdllExtensions.cpp, and FileLocksmith.cpp.
proposed_comments.title: Preserve HandleInfo::kernel_file_name and path_to_kernel_name for source compatibility

proposed_comments.body:
### Add regression unit tests for canonical DOS and NT kernel path helpers

**Severity:** medium`n
Add unit test coverage in FileLocksmithCLITests.cpp (TestCanonicalAndKernelPathHelpers) verifying that path_to_canonical_name returns a valid DOS/UNC formatted path (not an NT \Device\ path) and that path_to_kernel_name returns an NT device path (\Device\...). This ensures path canonicalization and fallback behavior cannot silently regress.

confidence.rationale: The unit test verifies both resolution paths against temporary files and passed cleanly in the candidate build.

proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: This requires adding a new test method in FileLocksmithCLITests.cpp in the test project rather than editing the interop library diff directly.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: This requires adding a new test method in FileLocksmithCLITests.cpp in the test project rather than editing the interop library diff directly.
proposed_comments.title: Add regression unit tests for canonical DOS and NT kernel path helpers
